_help: Help & feedback › FAQ. Edit freely; shown in this order.

faq.question: Why does the alarm keep ringing?
faq.answer: That's the point: the alarm only stops for good when you finish your mission. Pressing X silences it for a few minutes (your re-ring time), then it rings again. After the fail-safe limit it gives up, so you never get stuck.

faq.question: Does it ring when my phone is on silent or in a Focus?
faq.answer: Yes. Gloop uses iOS alarms, which ring through silent mode and Focus, as long as Alarms is allowed in Settings › Permissions.

faq.question: What happens if I force-quit the app?
faq.answer: The alarm still rings, and so do the re-rings: they're scheduled with iOS. The sound in between only plays while the app is running, so opening it gets you to your mission fastest.

faq.question: Can I wake up to a Spotify song?
faq.answer: No. iOS doesn't let apps play Spotify songs as alarms. You can pick an Apple Music song (plays during your mission), import your own audio file, or record a message.

faq.question: My item scan isn't recognised.
faq.answer: Scan the item again in good light, from the angles you'll see it in the morning, and hold it fully in view. Still stuck? After 2 minutes you can switch to the backup mission.

faq.question: Can I do the sky mission when it's dark or raining?
faq.answer: Yes. Day, night, clouds and rain all count, as long as the camera sees the real sky through a window or outside. Can't see it at all? Tap "Can't see the sky? Do another mission" and you get another mission right away.

faq.question: Scanning something in the dark?
faq.answer: Tap the flashlight button in the top-right corner of the camera: Auto, On or Off. On Auto, Gloop switches the flashlight on by itself when it's too dark to scan. It works for every camera mission except the sky.

faq.question: How do streaks, XP and stickers work?
faq.answer: Every morning you finish a mission adds a day to your streak and earns XP: more on the first ring, less for each re-ring, plus a streak bonus. XP evolves Gloop from a tiny Droplet all the way to King Gloop, with a new accessory at every stage. Days without an alarm, or paused days, don't break your streak. Stickers are collected for milestones like your first squish or a flawless week.

faq.question: How do I pause alarms for a holiday?
faq.answer: Settings › Pause all alarms. Pick how long; your alarms come back on their own afterwards.

faq.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
faq.answer: Settings › Gloop Pro › Manage subscription, or in iOS Settings › your name › Subscriptions. Deleting your account does not cancel a subscription.

faq.question: What data does Gloop collect?
faq.answer: Anonymous usage statistics (which screens and features are used, how onboarding and mornings go) via TelemetryDeck in the EU, with a random ID that isn't linked to your account. Never your name, email, alarm names, photos or anything you type. Turn it off any time in Settings › Privacy. Your alarms, sounds and item scans stay on your iPhone; with an account, your profile and Buddies data are stored with Supabase in the EU.
